verdict.rationale: Docusign is an agreement and eSignature platform, so shipping standard formation paperwork is a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows only generic signing, reusable templates and contract generation. Nothing documents founder stock purchase agreements, IP assignment forms or 83(b) election paperwork. Generic templates are an adjacent feature, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can complete post-incorporation setup — founder stock purchases, IP assignment, and 83(b) elections — with correct standard paperwork
